findings.anchor: .loop/plans/apm-per-package/README.md (What follows the move, the consumer entry)
findings.claim: The plan uses root-release-cutoff's LAST_ROOT_RELEASE (v0.12.2) to pick `path: packages/kmctl/apm`, but that constant marks when kmctl's Python code moved, not when apm/ moves. The two match only if this ticket lands before the next release from main. If any release ships between the two (main already cut v0.12.2 from the root while the packages move was in flight, which is why root-release-cutoff exists), that tag has packages/kmctl but apm/ at the root. new_entry(), the starter and the docs would then point at a path that tag does not have, and apm install fails. The plan neither guards against this nor says the two moves must ship in one release. Fix: state that they ship together and extend root-release-cutoff's tag test so every tag after the cutoff also has packages/kmctl/apm/apm.yml and none at or before it does. Or give the APM path its own cutoff.

Upgrading across the cutoff is not covered. doctor's _update_fix (packages/kmctl/src/kmctl/doctor.py:169-175) tells the user to 'set kmctl's ref in apm.yml to vX', and cli-version-floor and the install how-tos give the same steps. A project with `{path: apm, ref: v0.12.2}` that follows this advice to v0.13.0 gets an entry whose path the tag lacks, and apm install fails. The plan only has doctor and plugin *recognise* both paths. The fix advice (doctor's update fix, plugin patch's error hints and the docs' upgrade steps) must say to change the path too, and a test must cover an old-path project on a new CLI getting advice that installs.

O1's touches leave out sites that break or go quiet when apm/ moves. scripts/sync_antigravity_rules.py has SOURCE/TARGET under ROOT/apm. The `files:` regex `^(apm/(claude|antigravity)/...` in .pre-commit-config.yaml would stop matching, so the Antigravity rules sync stops firing with no error. The `paths:` globs in .claude/rules/diagrams-stay-current.md, adversarial-reviews.md, skills-via-skill-creator.md and skills-are-thin.md would stop scoping those rules. .okf/architecture/audit-pipeline.md has `resource:` paths into apm/.apm. ADR 0001, 0012, 0014, 0020 and 0021, the manifesto, the summary and docs/reference/commands.md all give the path. Many tests also read ROOT/apm: test_apm_package, test_opencode, test_antigravity, test_docs_frontmatter, test_verify, test_summary, test_briefing, test_docs, test_repo_name, test_pin, conftest, tests/test_skills, test_audit, test_agent, test_workspace_layout, test_check_wheel and test_release_skill. The prose says 'every test that reads apm/' and 'the other rules', but touches is what plan.split and the reviewers read, and it omits the sync script and the pre-commit hook entirely.

findings.anchor: .loop/plans/apm-per-package/README.md (What follows the move, the consumer entry)
findings.claim: One cutoff for two moves. The plan now says both moves ship in the first release after LAST_ROOT_RELEASE, because both land on agent-audit before it merges to main. It also extends root-release-cutoff's test_cutoff_matches_tags so every tag after the cutoff has packages/kmctl/apm/apm.yml and no apm/apm.yml, and every older tag the reverse. If main cuts a release from the root in between, that test fails and the cutoff moves for both.

Upgrade advice across the cutoff. _update_fix (doctor.py:170-176) now has to give the whole {git, path, ref} entry. The install how-tos and cli-version-floor.md say a move across the cutoff changes the path. The starter's apm.yml.jinja picks the path from kmctl_ref. A doctor test covers a {path: apm, ref: v0.12.2} project on this CLI getting a fix that names path: packages/kmctl/apm. I found no other code that rewrites only the ref: new_entry is the only writer, and the starter's upgrade recipe re-renders apm.yml.jinja.

Touches now include .pre-commit-config.yaml, scripts/sync_antigravity_rules.py, .claude/rules/*.md, .okf/decisions/*.md (including the resource: sources of 0020 and others), manifesto, summary, audit-pipeline, overview, docs/reference/commands.md, and test globs for packages/kmctl/tests, tests and tests/scripts. A fresh grep turns up only comment mentions outside touches (kinds.py:20 and the okf-stop-check.sh fixture header) plus history files (.okf/log.md, .okf/prototypes). None of these breaks when the folder moves.
